# LetsChat

> LetsChat is a free, open-source (GNU GPLv3), self-hosted team chat app with text channels, direct messages, voice and video calls and screen sharing. It is a self-hosted alternative to Discord: the desktop app runs on macOS, Windows and Linux, and the server runs on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose.

## Product

- [Home](https://letschat.stoaz.net/): features and a comparison with Discord
- [Download](https://letschat.stoaz.net/download/): desktop installers for macOS, Windows and Linux
- [Roadmap](https://letschat.stoaz.net/roadmap/): shipped and planned features

## Self-hosting

- [Self-hosting guide](https://letschat.stoaz.net/self-hosting/): requirements and choosing a setup
- [Cloudflare Tunnel setup](https://letschat.stoaz.net/self-hosting/cloudflare-tunnel/): no open inbound ports except voice
- [Caddy setup](https://letschat.stoaz.net/self-hosting/caddy/): reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS
- [Architecture](https://letschat.stoaz.net/architecture/): services in the stack and where data lives
- [Breaking changes](https://letschat.stoaz.net/breaking-changes/): upgrade notes per release
